thread:
kevin_r: hi all — first day here. trying to enroll my MacBook Air (macOS 14.5) into Jamf via the onboarding link and it fails with 'TLS: certificate unknown'. i'm on home wifi. any tips? :wave:
it_helpdesk: welcome @kevin_r! often this means the Redwood internal root CA isn't in the System keychain. Did you install the onboarding cert bundle we emailed?
kevin_r: i only see the wifi profile and the enroll link in my onboarding email. no cert bundle.
ops_bot: quick checklist: 1) sw_vers -productVersion 2) security find-certificate -a -c "Redwood Internal CA" 3) try hotspot to rule out captive portal
kevin_r: sw_vers: 14.5
security lookup returned nothing. tried phone hotspot, same result.
it_helpdesk: sounds like our new root cert rollout missed the onboarding batch. @mark_sre we rolled certs yesterday — can you confirm new root is live and reissue the onboarding pkg?
mark_sre: confirmed there was a cert swap. we'll repackage the root installer and a system-level .pkg. @it_helpdesk i'll push the package to the secure share — it needs admin to install (System keychain).
it_helpdesk: sent secure link to @kevin_r. note: install to System keychain (not login) and reboot. if you don't have admin, request temporary sudo and we'll issue a 2-hour token.
kevin_r: i don't have admin. requesting temp sudo now.
it_helpdesk: granted 2-hour admin token via DM. also included a one-click installer for the Wi-Fi profile and the .mobileconfig for manual enrollment if needed.
kevin_r: installed cert, rebooted. enrollment now advances but System Prefs -> Profiles shows 'Approve management' and it asks for a consent code.
it_helpdesk: consent codes are one-time and are in the onboarding email; if missing we generate and DM them. @mark_sre can you create code for serial: C02Z7YVAN567?
mark_sre: code generated: P8K-4ZT-2N9 (sent via DM).
kevin_r: entered code and approved. enrollment completed. fdesetup status shows "FileVault Off" — will it enable automatically?
it_helpdesk: our policy enforces FileVault but macOS sometimes defers enable until first login. i'm pushing an MDM task to initiate enable + escrow key. ops_bot: Deploy job 6213 started -> push/filevault-enable -> target: C02Z7YVAN567
it_helpdesk: pushed. you should see a prompt on next logout/login to enable FileVault. we'll escrow the recovery token to KMS.
kevin_r: prompt showed up and i enabled. thanks. one more: how do i get sudo for brew and Docker?
it_helpdesk: default is non-admin. for onboarding we grant temporary 7-day sudo; fill the short form (link DM) and we'll apply. after 7 days it's auto-revoked.
elaine_pd: for dev folks we try to limit admin windows; if you need persistent build infra we have a reproducible container and CI builders. reach out to #dev-env for exceptions.
kevin_r: requested 7-day sudo and ran the bootstrap script — brew and docker installed fine. FileVault status: "On". everyone super helpful, thanks!
it_helpdesk: marking resolved. if anything else pops up open a ticket and include the serial. welcome to Redwood! :tada:
